# Data Source: identitynow_personal_access_token

Use this data source to look up a personal access token by name. The token secret is not available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_personal_access_token" "reporting" {
  name = "reporting"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Token name.

### Optional

- `owner_id` (String) Identity ID of the token owner. Defaults to the identity the provider authenticates as. Looking up tokens of other identities requires the `idn:all-personal-access-tokens:read` right.

### Read-Only

- `access_token_validity_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds an access token generated with this token is valid.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date, null when the token never expires.
- `id` (String) Token ID.
- `last_used` (String) Date the token was last used to generate an access token. It is updated once a day.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the token is managed by the SailPoint platform.
- `owner` (Attributes List) Identity that owns the token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `scope` (Set of String) Scopes of the token.
- `user_aware_token_never_expires` (Boolean) Whether a token that never expires was acknowledged.

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner identity ID.
- `name` (String) Owner display name.
- `type` (String) Owner type, `IDENTITY`.
